title: Plan overlay beats for a talking-head video
what_it_does: Skill that turns footage plus transcript into a paced set of motion graphics: what the viewer should remember, glass lower thirds versus full-screen takeovers, anchors in the transcript, and not covering the speaker needlessly.
when_to_use: Deciding where cards and callouts go on a long talking-head video.
why: MIT; HyperFrames-specific and matches the beat validator; the AIS brand examples must be removed.
